metadata_census.limit: Entire explicit named metadata census inspected; arbitrary per-study receipts/results outside these names and unavailable sourceoriginals not exhaustively reconciled. Public ledger is complete only for listed sourcecells, not proof every privateattempt/result ispublic.
metadata_census.private_named_metadata_manifest_reproduc: Regenerate metadata-only filemanifest with this pinned runner; full ordered filehash manifest is hashed rather than publicly duplicating private paths.

method_contract_references.learned_parameter_bodies: Omitted frompublic aggregate; original privateartifacts retained; not reconstructablefromhashalone.

method_families.name: Retained original provider points
method_families.recipe: Recorded values only; no regenerated historical provider forecasts.

method_families.name: Pinned website adjustment
method_families.recipe: Original point multiplied by round(clip(1+(r-1)*n/(n+8),.75,1.25),3), with original category eligibility/rounding/fallback.

method_families.name: Recent supported production
method_families.recipe: (n*recent_mean3+3*earlier_role_prior)/(n+3), with qualified-window and fixed fallback rules.

method_families.name: Pooled/shrunk production
method_families.recipe: (n*recent_mean8+5*earlier_role_prior)/(n+5), with explicit missing-window fallback.

method_families.name: Opportunity times efficiency
method_families.recipe: Separate fixed component-recent opportunity and pooled/shrunk efficiency; exact target recipes and fallback in models.py.

method_families.name: Regularized direct point/event models
method_families.recipe: Ridge alpha32; logistic for Bernoulli; earlier-only imputation, standardization and position/category design.

method_families.name: Fixed ExtraTrees direct model
method_families.recipe: 24trees/depth6/minleaf30/maxfeatures.8/seed1701; earlier-only feature/label fits, not an unlimited search.

method_families.name: Parametric count/signed/event laws
method_families.recipe: Negative-binomial/Poisson counts, normal signed totals and Bernoulli with fixed earlier residual/prior spread; distinct from later empirical CDF.

method_families.name: Original fixed point ensemble
method_families.recipe: 0.5*ridge +0.25*workload +0.25*recent; numeric point averaging is not a full-law mixture.

method_families.name: Ridge without opponent/workload/team
method_families.recipe: Same earlier-only learner with one predeclared feature group removed; no group selected retrospectively.

method_families.name: 28-feature public NGS addition
method_families.recipe: Hold fixed ridge/logistic; add prior NGS context only. Three small primary gains, eight losses in exposed2023.

method_families.name: 47-feature PBP/schedule addition
method_families.recipe: Hold learner fixed; prior team/opponent style, tempo proxy, rest, lagged coach/venue. All11 primary losses worsen.

method_families.name: SITE-held three-appearance pooled YPA
method_families.recipe: Original SITE attempt point * sum(H3 pass_yd)/sum(H3 pass_att); exactly3 qualified appearances; unchanged SITE-yard fallback.

method_families.name: SITE-held pooled completion conversion
method_families.recipe: Original SITE attempt point * sum(H3 completions)/sum(H3 attempts), original selected H3 and unchanged completion fallback.

method_families.name: Frozen attempts workload GLM
method_families.recipe: Log-link mean of training-standardized log1p(player H3 attempts), log1p(team G5 attempts), positive-attempt fraction and missing flags; lambda1; original parameters/artifact gaps retained.

method_families.name: Historical pooled passing efficiency
method_families.recipe: Hold saved tree attempts fixed; multiply by H3 or H8 pooled YPA with commonH8 eligibility/fallback. Both lose pooled yard control.

method_families.name: Historical pooled rushing efficiency
method_families.recipe: Hold saved tree carries fixed; multiply H3/H8 pooled YPC. H8 small gain versus pooled, with adverse bias/tails and intervals crossing0.

method_families.name: Original five-season RB carry-share proposal
method_families.recipe: mu=tau*(SC+kappa*p0)/(ST+kappa), original five-prior-season p0/tau0 and kappa{0,25,100}; original history/fallback/window retained.

method_families.name: Frozen reception half-adjustment
method_families.recipe: raw_rec+.5*(adjusted_rec-raw_rec); original registration and2026Weeks7-14, no restart/backfill.

method_families.name: Projected targets times H3 pooled YPT
method_families.recipe: Same-cutoff projected targets * sum(H3 rec_yd)/sum(H3 targets); exact-three history/source adapter and unchanged SITE fallback.

method_families.name: Same-receipt combined-yard point
method_families.recipe: SITE rush_yd + SITE rec_yd on identical eligible rows; missing components retain registered fallback.

method_families.name: Empirical-leaf marginal forecast law
method_families.recipe: 32 ExtraTrees/depth8/minleaf30/seed1701; 95% leaf empirical distribution +5% earlier role/global support prior.

method_families.name: Absolute-error/binary histogram boosting
method_families.recipe: 150iterations/.05/depth3/15leaves/minleaf30/L2=10/seed1702; numeric point heuristic, binary genuine class probability.

method_families.name: Count objective and role-specific boosting
method_families.recipe: Poisson objective on six counts; B separates roles; passing singleton and noncount aliases retained. Legacy prior-median fallback distinct from mean-v2.

method_families.name: Corrected intended-mean Count A
method_families.recipe: Same registered Poisson-HGB specification, separately refitted in18V2 calls; required fallback uses stored prior.mean, not prior.median. Original frozen procedure not overwritten.

method_families.name: Six native direct configurations
method_families.recipe: XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost ×small64-depth3 ormedium128-depth5; LR.05/L2=10; quantile.5 yards, Poisson counts, binary logloss.

method_families.name: Intercept/context corrections to honest CDF
method_families.recipe: Corrections trained on earlier out-of-fold baseline predictions; log mean offset for counts and logit offset for events, exact frozen regularization/preprocessing.

method_families.name: Monotone threshold-distribution challenger
method_families.recipe: Fixed threshold classifiers and monotone valid CDF construction with full-support tails; same information as controls.

method_families.name: Distribution-sensitive response forest
method_families.recipe: ExtraTrees splits on weighted indicator CDF response grid; empirical outcome leaves plus5% support prior; binary arm exact leaf alias.

method_families.name: Four probability recalibrations on two bases
method_families.recipe: Intercept-only, constrained Platt, constrained beta and increasing isotonic trained earlier-only; true infinite log losses retained.

method_families.name: Fixed80% chronological CQR
method_families.recipe: Earlier calibration residuals choose interval radius; all20 radii zero; point and CDF unchanged.

method_families.name: P0/P1/P2/P3/P4
method_families.recipe: Reference; previous-week; cumulative; nested earlier-only recency; frozen equal shortlist blend. Retain all losing weeks and startup/fallback.

method_families.name: Equal and shrunk probability stacking
method_families.recipe: Fixed .5CDF+.5Cat; earlier-only scalar Brier weight shrunk toward .5 with lambda.001; exactly2 weight fits.

method_families.name: Fixed marginals, independence versus Gaussian copula
method_families.recipe: Randomized discrete PIT, correlation shrink n/(n+100),4096 fixed draws, sum components per draw; direct-total and Cat controls.

method_families.name: Smooth-H8-k25 role shares with held efficiency
method_families.recipe: Fixed decayed team/player shares; half-life8/team slots, shrink25, fixed100-strength efficiency prior; same fallbacks/control population.

method_families.name: Original recorded threshold directions
method_families.recipe: 13 fixed point procedures; exact retained line/player/game cohort. Direction accuracy is not calibrated probability or EV.

method_families.name: Exact versioned website scoring transform
method_families.recipe: Original18primitive fields and conditional defensive-recovery attribution; no unsupported rare component imputed0.

method_families.name: Timestamped factual context intake
method_families.recipe: Source-linked identity/time/conflict records; no invented injury penalties or private gameplan access.

method_families.name: Interception-worthy and catch-quality features
method_families.recipe: Permitted source/schema recovery distinct from qualified joins/as-of features; no completed incremental model comparison.

method_families.name: Native conditional-law boosting
method_families.recipe: Poisson/Bernoulli/signed law API and genuine synthetic runtime verified; six-fit NFL preparation inert and paused, previous failures retained.

method_families.name: ExactDRF/MMD,XGBoostLSS,AdaBoost,rich role/joint/market extensions
method_families.recipe: Not completed by mentioning libraries, acquiring metadata or building software fixtures. No measured gain assigned.
